cases.expected: sdlc/state-20261008101500; 14 UTC digits for '' and None; sdlc/state-0 for 0 and '0'

seeds.title: name does not check its output with git check-ref-format
seeds.detail: Hostile ts, id and profile values give names such as sdlc/state-../../x, sdlc/a\nb-v0-http-api-0 and sdlc/state-@{u}. 48 of 103 ts values and 73 of 250 id/profile values give ref-unsafe names. The spec does not require a valid ref from name, and callers are the loop itself, so this is not a blocker. A check in name or in tail would give a clean exit 2.

seeds.title: Negative round, part and n give names that parse cannot read back
seeds.detail: argparse int() accepts -1, so --round -1 gives sdlc/S-001-v-1-http-api-0 and --n -1 gives sdlc/S-001-attempt--1. The spec parse regexes use \d+, so these names do not round-trip. It also accepts +1, 1_000, padded whitespace, unicode digits and 4300-digit values. Refuse negative values in tail or with a non-negative type.

seeds.title: T-R-119 text scan misses a push of a verify name built on another line
seeds.detail: A mutant adds vb = f"sdlc/{sid}-v{r}-{prof}-{k}" and then git(repo, "push", "-q", "origin", vb) to state-write.py. T-R-119 still passes. The scan also does not read skills/sdlc/tracker/*.py. No current code has this shape; the plan names this risk.

seeds.title: Fail message says 'a attempt branch name'
seeds.detail: tail('attempt') without n raises 'a attempt branch name needs a non-empty n'. The article is wrong for kinds that start with a vowel (attempt, e2e, e2e-area).
